_doc: sha256 of the gitignored tiny checkpoint each committed golden was recorded from. The pin scripts random-initialise these checkpoints and do NOT reproduce the same weights across torch/transformers versions (bailing_hybrid's not even run to run), so a checkpoint regenerated on another box silently pairs a committed golden with different weights and the parity test fails with a meaningless cosine. Tests check this first (decoder/fixture_identity_test.go). When you re-pin a fixture, commit its golden(s) AND update its hash here in the same commit. See docs/measurements/tiny-fixture-golden-mismatch-2026-09-24.md.

bailing_hybrid-tiny.pin: scripts/pin_bailing_hybrid_tiny.py (not deterministic even run to run)
